name: coustard
description: Coustard is a display and text serif webfont designed to be used freely across the internet by web browsers on desktop computers, laptops and mobile devices. Coustard has been developed from a fork of Tienne, another font in the Google Font Directory, available under the SIL Open Font License which allows for remixing fonts.
